prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: fresh paper coins; the runway; tape pieces.
Opens on the runway, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as fresh paper coins are taped onto the runway one after another, extending it across the frame.
Ends holding on the extended runway.
This composition is small-scale: a single subject sits alone on open ground.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "+$13.8M".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "+$13.8M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage animation, presented as a 2D motion design photographed flat under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a pink paper ground with a cream-colored paper chip in the upper third displaying the text "1.4 MONTHS" in bold black sans-serif, and a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an airplane on a grey paper runway strip, all characterized by rough white torn-paper edges and soft shadows cast from a light source in the upper left. Immediately, the camera remains in a Static Shot as the pink background is suddenly covered by a single, unbroken block of lime green paper. Simultaneously, the "1.4 MONTHS" chip slides quickly off-screen to the left with a slight overshoot. In the upper third of the frame, a new cream-colored paper chip lands crisply, featuring the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "+$13.8M", which remains stable, clean, and legible throughout the rest of the video. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, the grey runway strip remains, but fresh black-and-white halftone paper coin cutouts—plain, unmarked, and matte—begin to enter the frame rapidly. One by one, these coins are "taped" onto the end of the runway using small, rectangular strips of matte cream-colored paper tape. Each coin lands with a slight overshoot before settling. As the coins are added in a fast sequence, they physically extend the runway horizontally across the lime green ground. The composition is small-scale, emphasizing the isolated runway and coins against the vast green negative space. The video concludes by holding this final composition of the extended runway and the "+$13.8M" headline, with a subtle, barely perceptible loop of the paper elements shifting.

overall_soundscape: A sequence of crisp, rhythmic paper-slap sounds as the coin cutouts land on the ground. These are punctuated by the short, sticky, tactile sound of adhesive tape being pressed down onto paper.
